[P1] 5、骑在扫帚上听歌的巫婆

zài
sào
zhǒu
shàng

[P2] 从前,有个巫婆,她叫什么名字我弄不清楚。只知道她像所有的巫婆一样,用一把古老的长扫帚做飞行的工具。
巫婆经常骑着她的长扫帚出门赶路。天空中的小鸟看见巫婆飞过时,都会高叫一声:“嘿,你好,巫婆!”
巫婆也会在扫帚上摆动身子,挥手说:“嘿,小鸟们,你们好!”
这天,巫婆想出门,去远处大榕树下的乌鸦家。谁都知道,巫婆和乌鸦是好朋友呢。
你好!
你好!

[P3] 巫婆已经有三个星期没见到她的好朋友了。巫婆一跨腿，上了她的扫帚，就像人们骑上自行车一样。巫婆说了声：“飞！”她就驾驶着扫帚在天空中飞了起来。扫帚的飞行速度可比自行车快多了，快得连小鸟们都追不上。巫婆刚飞出家门不久，就追上了一只小鸟。她认识这只小鸟，小鸟的名字叫“巧嘴”。
“巧嘴”的嘴很巧，能唱出各种各样的歌。可是今天不知道为什么，“巧嘴”没有唱歌。它沉默着，而且飞得很慢，更让人惊奇的是，当巫婆从“巧嘴”身边飞过的时候，“巧嘴”竟然没有像平时那样，清脆地叫一声：“嘿，你好，巫婆！”

[P4] 巫婆觉得有点不对劲，尽管已经飞过小鸟身边，她还是转了一下扫帚柄，又飞回小鸟身边，关心地问：“嘿！小巧嘴，你怎么了？”

“巧嘴”还在艰难地飞着，他没开口，先滚落了两行泪。

原来，他刚才在树上啄果子吃，飞上又跳下，因为太高兴了，把翅膀给扭伤了，所以飞起来很是痛苦。

巫婆弄清楚了是怎么回事，就说：
“啊，这有什么好愁眉苦脸的，请停在我的扫帚柄上吧！让我把你载到我的好朋友乌鸦那，他是个挺出色的骨科大夫。让他帮你按摩一下，就会没事的。”

[P5] “巧嘴”一听，可高兴了，他停在巫婆扫帚柄前端，仿佛在为巫婆指路似的。当然，巫婆根本不用人指路，这条去大榕树的路，她闭上眼睛也能准确无误地飞到。

“巧嘴”收起翅膀，不再艰难地飞行，他觉得舒服多了。巫婆的扫帚飞得比鸟儿快得多，迎面吹来呼呼的风，“巧嘴”只想张嘴唱歌。

像是看透了“巧嘴”的心思，巫婆也想边飞边听音乐。她说：“巧嘴，唱支歌吧，我太想听歌了。”

“哦！可以吗？”“巧嘴”说，“不是说飞行的时候不宜唱歌、听音乐吗？弄不好会出交通事故的。”

“管它呢！”巫婆让扫帚使劲朝

[P6] 下,他们“嗖”地飞得更高了!
“老实说,我从小就喜欢一边听音乐、唱歌,一边看书、做功课。从来是两不误的。”
“我这样做,我妈妈会骂我的!”
“巧嘴”低声说。
“我妈妈以前也骂我,可是这又有什么关系,我还是照样听歌、看书。
哼! 我也不从巫婆学校毕业了吗?”
巫婆没好意思说出来,她以前边做作业边听音乐,所以做题目常出错,她
小时候的外号是“错误大王”。
这是小学的时候,中学里呢,她是有名的“补考大王”。一门功课考个两三次才及格,也是常有的事。不过,这些倒霉事都过去了,现在她可是个合格的巫婆。一个合格的巫婆飞在天上,听听音乐,哼哼曲子也不行吗?
就一定会出事吗? 她才不相信呢!
“唱你的歌吧!”巫婆把扫帚柄朝左边一推,他们向左边飞去。

[P7] “巧嘴”清清嗓子，开始唱起歌来：
“叽叽叽，来来来，哒哒哒，咯咯咯！”
歌唱得很动听，巫婆边听边摇晃着身子，嘴里不停地哼哼着，她的扫帚也随着圆舞曲上下左右转着圈，舞了起来。
“1，2，3；2，2，3；3，2，3……” 一圈
又一圈，一圈又一圈，他俩在天空画了一个又一个圆圈。不一会儿，巫婆和“巧嘴”都头晕了，就像刚喝了一瓶酒一样。

[P8] “啊！行了行了。”巫婆说，
“咱们不能再转圈了！要不然
会从扫帚上摔出去的。”
“行！”“巧嘴”说，“咱们不
唱圆舞曲了，唱支带劲的进行
曲吧！”
“喔，唱吧！”巫婆摇晃着
身子说。
“巧嘴”大声唱了起来：“轰
轰轰，浪浪浪，我们是箭，我们
是风；快快快，快快快，冲冲
冲，冲冲冲。”
巫婆随着“巧嘴”
一起唱了起来：“冲
冲冲，冲冲冲！”
巫婆越唱越来
劲，两条腿夹紧扫帚，
一只手使劲挥舞着，
就像飞舞着一根马
鞭。扫帚像箭一样
向前射去，速度比平
时快五倍，也还还不

[P9] 止呢。
这时，只听见一阵警报声，巫婆收住扫帚一看，一位骑着特大号扫帚的巫婆警察停立在她的面前：“女士，你飞行超速，按规定，罚款500巫币，这是违规罚款单，请去违规罚款中心缴费。”
“咦？我的飞行记录一直良好。”
巫婆想申辩几句。

“不用多说，”巫婆警察说，“我的测速仪器显示你已经超速五倍了。不过，我并没有给你开比平时高五倍的罚款单。你够幸运的了。”

[P10] 和警察是不能多争辩的，巫婆只能自认晦气，收好罚款单，重新飞行。由于刚才的进行曲太刺激，她心中的兴奋还没有散尽。巫婆对“巧嘴”说：“唱一支摇篮曲吧，让我们松弛一下，这样就不会超速了。”“巧嘴”唱起了一支动听的摇篮曲。摇篮曲很温柔，很甜蜜。巫婆听着听着，不由得打起了瞌睡——这可太危险了。猛然，巫婆整个身子朝前一倾，她无意间把扫帚柄朝下一按。扫帚、巫婆和扫帚柄上的“巧嘴”一起朝下冲去，差一点掉进一条河里！幸亏巫婆及时清醒，他们才重新飞上了蓝天。

[P11] “巧嘴”说第二句话的时候，正好让在身边飞过的那位巫婆警察听到了。巫婆警察非常高兴，认为巫婆是一位很遵守飞行规则、很合格的扫帚驾驶员，她收回了之前给巫婆的罚款单，算是一种奖励。巫婆驾驶着扫帚在天空中飞着，‘巧嘴’一声不响地在扫帚柄上站着。这时巫婆很想告诉‘巧嘴’，她明白了以前她为什么会有‘错误大王’和‘补考大王’的外号，因为她做事太不专心了——一边听音乐、唱歌一边做作业会出错，一边听音乐、唱歌一边驾驶扫帚同样也不行，做什么事情都得专心。

[P1] 5. The Witch Riding a Broomstick and Listening to Music
qí
zài
sào
zhǒu
shàng
tīng
ge
de
wū
pó

[P2] Long ago, there was a witch. I don't know her name. I only know that, like all witches, she used an old broom as her flying tool.

The witch often rode her long broom to go out. When birds in the sky saw the witch flying by, they would shout, "Hey, hello, witch!"

The witch would also wiggle her body on the broom and wave, saying, "Hey, little birds, hello!"

This day, the witch wanted to go out, to the crow's home under the big banyan tree. Everyone knows the witch and the crow are good friends.

Hello!
Hello!

[P3] The witch hadn't seen her good friend for three weeks. The witch stepped onto her broom, just like people get on a bicycle. She said, "Fly!" and then she flew through the sky on her broom. The broom's flying speed was much faster than a bicycle, so fast that even the little birds couldn't catch up. Soon after flying out of her door, the witch caught up with a little bird. She recognized this bird; its name was "Clever Beak".
"Clever Beak" had a clever beak and could sing all kinds of songs. But today, for some unknown reason, "Clever Beak" didn't sing. It was silent and flying very slowly. Even more surprising was that when the witch flew past "Clever Beak", the bird didn't call out as usual with a clear voice: "Hey, hello, witch!"

[P4] The witch felt something was wrong. Even though she had already flown past the little bird, she turned her broomstick and flew back, asking with concern, "Hey! Little Chirp, what's wrong?"

"Chirp" was still struggling to fly. He didn't speak, but two tears rolled down his cheeks.

It turned out that he had just been pecking fruits on the tree, jumping up and down with excitement, and had twisted his wing, making it very painful to fly.

The witch understood what had happened and said:
"Ah, there's no need to look so worried. Please stop on my broomstick! I'll take you to my good friend the crow. He's a very skilled bone doctor. Let him massage it for you, and you'll be fine."

[P5] "Chaozui" heard and was so happy. He perched on the front of the witch's broomstick, as if guiding her. Of course, the witch didn't need anyone to guide her. She could fly accurately and without error to the big banyan tree, even with her eyes closed.

"Chaozui" folded his wings and no longer struggled to fly. He felt much more comfortable. The witch's broom flew much faster than a bird, and a whooshing wind blew in their faces. "Chaozui" just wanted to open his beak and sing.

As if reading "Chaozui"'s mind, the witch also wanted to fly and listen to music. She said, "Chaozui, sing a song! I really want to hear music."

"Oh! Really?" "Chaozui" said, "Didn't we say it's not advisable to sing or listen to music while flying? It might cause an accident."

"Who cares!" the witch said, making the broom push forward.

[P6] Down below, they zoomed higher!
"Honestly, I've always loved listening to music and singing while reading and doing homework. I've never failed to do both."
"If I do that, my mom will scold me!"
"Qiaozui" whispered.
"My mom used to scold me too, but what does that matter? I still listen to music and read books.
Hmph! I didn't graduate from Witch School either, did I?"
The witch didn't want to admit it, but she used to do homework while listening to music, so she often made mistakes on her assignments. She
used to be called the 'Mistake King' when she was young.
In elementary school, and in middle school, she was famously the 'Retake King'. It was common for her to pass a subject only after two or three attempts. But those unlucky days are over. Now she's a qualified witch. A qualified witch flying in the sky, listening to music, humming tunes—why not?
Would that really cause trouble? She didn't believe it!
"Sing your song!" The witch pushed the broomstick to the left, and they flew off to the left.

[P7] "Qiaozui" cleared her throat and began to sing:
"Ji ji ji, lai lai lai, da da da, ge ge ge!"
The song was very pleasant. The witch swayed her body, humming continuously, while her broom danced up and down, left and right, following the waltz.
"1, 2, 3; 2, 2, 3; 3, 2, 3..." One round,
then another, round after round, they drew circle after circle in the sky. In no time, both the witch and "Qiaozui" felt dizzy, just like after drinking a bottle of wine.

[P8] "Ah! Alright, alright," the witch said, 
"We can't keep spinning anymore! Otherwise, 
we'll fall off the broom!"
"Alright!" said "Chaozui," "Let's not 
sing a waltz anymore, let's sing a lively march 
instead!"
"Oh, go ahead!" the witch said, swaying 
her body.
"Chaozui" sang loudly: "Boom, boom, boom, 
wave, wave, wave, we are arrows, we are wind; 
fast, fast, fast, fast, fast, fast, charge, charge, 
charge!"
The witch sang along with "Chaozui": 
"Charge, charge, charge!"
The witch sang more and more energetically, 
her two legs tightly gripping the broom, 
one hand waving vigorously, 
just like dancing with a whip. The broom shot 
forward like an arrow, faster than usual 
by five times, and still not...

[P9] Stop.
At that moment, a siren blared. The witch stopped her broom and looked up to see a witch police officer riding a giant broom, standing before her: "Madam, you are flying over the speed limit. According to regulations, you are fined 500 witch coins. Here is your violation ticket. Please go to the Violation Fine Center to pay." 
"Huh? My flight record has always been excellent."
The witch wanted to argue a few points.

"No need to say more," said the witch police officer, "my speed detector shows you're going five times over the limit. But I didn't give you a fine five times higher than usual. You're lucky."

[P10] The witch couldn't argue with the police, so she had to admit defeat, put away the fine, and resume flying. Since the march had been so exciting, her excitement hadn't faded yet. The witch said to "Qiaozui": "Sing a lullaby, let's relax a bit—this way we won't speed." "Qiaozui" sang a lovely lullaby. The lullaby was gentle and sweet. The witch, listening and listening, couldn't help dozing off—this was too dangerous. Suddenly, the witch leaned her whole body forward, accidentally pressing down on the broomstick. The broom, the witch, and "Qiaozui" on the broomstick all plunged downward, almost falling into a river! Fortunately, the witch woke up in time, and they flew back into the blue sky.

[P11] "Chaozui" said the second sentence, and just then, the witch police officer flying nearby heard it. The witch police officer was very happy, thinking the witch was a very rule-abiding and qualified broom rider. She took back the fine she had given the witch before, as a kind of reward. The witch was flying through the sky on her broom, while "Chaozui" stood silently on the broom handle. At this moment, the witch wanted to tell "Chaozui" that she now understood why she used to have the nicknames "Mistake King" and "Retake King"—because she was too inattentive. Doing homework while listening to music or singing would lead to mistakes, and driving the broom while doing the same was also not acceptable. One must always be focused on whatever they are doing.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本第5页的标题页，标题为“骑在扫帚上听歌的巫婆”，背景为浅橙色，带有模糊的图案纹理。
[P2] 本页介绍了故事中的巫婆，她骑着长扫帚飞行，与天空中的小鸟互相打招呼，今天她打算去大榕树下的乌鸦家做客。
[P3] 巫婆骑着扫帚飞行，途中遇到了她的好朋友小鸟“巧嘴”，但“巧嘴”今天异常沉默，没有像往常一样打招呼，这让巫婆感到惊讶。
[P4] 巫婆发现小鸟“巧嘴”飞行困难并流下眼泪，关心地询问后得知它因兴奋跳跃而扭伤了翅膀，于是决定带它去找好朋友乌鸦医生治疗。
[P5] 巫婆带着受伤的小鸟“巧嘴”飞行，巧嘴因翅膀扭伤而不再挣扎飞行，感到舒适并想唱歌。巫婆也想听歌，便邀请巧嘴唱歌，但巧嘴担心飞行时唱歌会出事故，巫婆则不以为意，让扫帚继续前进。
[P6] 巫婆和小鸟巧嘴在飞行途中继续对话，巧嘴分享自己从小听音乐做功课的习惯，巫婆则回忆自己过去因边听音乐边做作业而常出错，因此被称作“错误大王”和“补考大王”，如今她已成长为合格的巫婆，不再担心听音乐会出事，于是鼓励巧嘴唱歌，并推动扫帚向左飞行。
[P7] 巫婆带着小鸟“巧嘴”在空中飞行，巧嘴开始唱歌，巫婆边听边摇晃，扫帚随着音乐舞动，两人在天空画出许多圆圈，最终因旋转过快而感到头晕。
[P8] 巫婆和小鸟“巧嘴”在飞行中因旋转过快而感到头晕，巫婆劝阻继续转圈，巧嘴提议改唱进行曲，两人一起高歌，巫婆越唱越起劲，扫帚如箭般高速前进。
[P9] 巫婆和小鸟巧嘴在飞行途中被巫婆警察拦下，因超速被开罚单，但警察因同情未加重处罚，巫婆感到惊讶和幸运。
[P10] 巫婆和小鸟巧嘴在飞行中因听摇篮曲而放松，巫婆打起瞌睡，不慎按压扫帚柄导致急速下坠，险些掉入河中，幸而及时清醒，重新飞上蓝天。
[P11] 巫婆因遵守飞行规则被巫婆警察收回罚款单，作为奖励；她向小鸟巧嘴解释自己过去因做事不专心而得外号，并强调做任何事都需专心。
[P12] 画面中，一位戴着尖顶帽、穿着巫婆袍的小巫婆正骑着扫帚在空中飞行，扫帚后方飘着红色披风，下方有淡淡的云朵痕迹，整体氛围轻松愉快。
